description: Search indexed Swiss-eligible jobs from enabled sources. Inspect source_freshness and location_class; current means refreshable, not guaranteed open. No exhaustive market coverage.

category.description: Reviewed title-based role family, version 2026-10-27.2. Not an employer-sector filter.

company.description: Employer name contains this text; not a company ID. Maximum 48 UTF-8 bytes.

company_id.description: Exact canonical employer ID returned by company search; preferred for employer-specific queries.

employment_type.description: Employment type contains this text, e.g. full-time. Maximum 48 UTF-8 bytes.

geography.description: Work arrangement; does not imply Swiss remote eligibility.

location_class.description: Location evidence classification. Swiss search excludes ambiguous and non-Swiss results.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous response; maximum 5000.

q.description: Keywords. All searchable terms must match; searches titles and descriptions. At most 12 terms are interpreted. Maximum 200 UTF-8 bytes.

role.description: Reviewed occupational title collection, version 2026-11-04.1. Applied before pagination; may overlap other collections.

sector.description: Employer sector contains this text. Maximum 40 UTF-8 bytes.

sort.description: Default: relevance with keywords, otherwise newest.

name: search_jobs
title: Search Swiss jobs
